answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 23641 Country: India Title: I am 58 years old doing business. I had taken a loan from the bank to do business about 40 years back as my father had died. Since then, I am unable to pay the loan and clear the dues. I would like you to give me some dua or prayer where Allah will clear my dues and I would like to live according to the Shariat Question: I am 58 years old doing business. I had taken a loan from the bank to do business about 40 years back as my father had died. Since then, I am unable to pay the loan and clear the dues. I would like you to give me some dua or prayer where Allah will clear my dues and I would like to live according to the Shariat. Answer ID: 23641 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1378/1018/H=1431) Recite the following dua 100 times with durood 100-100 times before and after daily sitting at a place. اللّٰہُمِّ اکْفِنِیْ بِحَلاَلِکَ عَنْ حَرَامِکَ وَأغْنِنِيْ بِفَضْلِکَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاکَ Do the same at night before going to bed. Also recite Durood Ibrahimi extensively while every time. Also recite the holy Quran daily regularly according to your ease, and make yourself and all your family members punctual in salah. Make sure that your first takbir (with jama’ah) is not missed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
